messages:
Marta: kicking off v3.0.0 canary -> multi-region (us-east, eu-west) 10% traffic across rerank + chat at 4444444444. deploy-bot: started rollout id=6124 -> https://deploys.redwood/6124 :rocket:

deploy-bot: rollout 6124 started, routes=[rerank, chat], regions=[us-east, eu-west], traffic=10%

Chen: watching rerank SLOs. @Riley can you watch eu-west specifically?

Riley: watching https://console.redwood/slo/rerank-route (eu-west slice)  p95 jumped from 180ms -> 520ms and 5xx spiked to 1.3% (threshold 0.4%)

SLO-alert-bot: [CRITICAL] rerank-route (eu-west) 5xx=1.3% over 1m window  error-budget burn high

Marta: ouch. Is this cross-region or limited to eu-west?

Chen: us-east rerank looks OK (5xx ~0.2%). So localized to eu-west. Logs show upstream model-serve returning 503 bursts: ```2026-03-23T09:02:11Z error: model-serve-04 503 scheduling overload```

eng-runtime: early signal points to a sharded model warming regression in v3.0.0 for eu pool; cold-start tail + too-aggressive prefetch causing queue buildup. Suggest we STOP canary traffic for rerank in eu-west and pin that route to previous stable (v2.9.8) there, keep other routes/regions moving.

Marta: agree. Avoid global rollback. Plan: pause rerank in eu-west and pin to v2.9.8. Commands: `deployctl pause --rollout=6124 --route=rerank --region=eu-west` then `deployctl pin --route=rerank --region=eu-west --version=v2.9.8 --reason='eu canary 5xx spike'`

deploy-bot: pause command received... pause successful at 4444444490.

Riley: executing pin now: `deployctl pin --route=rerank --region=eu-west --version=v2.9.8 --reason='eu canary 5xx spike'` -> pin successful at 4444444502. rerank eu-west traffic reverted to v2.9.8.

Marta: great. Leave chat route and us-east rerank canary running. eng-runtime, can you collect traces & queue metrics from model-serve-04 and upload? We want to avoid re-roll until warmed/flag fix.

eng-runtime: traces uploaded: https://s3.redwood/6124/rerank-eu-traces.tar.gz. Quick read: request queue depth spikes at shard boundary during initial tokenization; prefetch window set to 6 in v3.0.0 seems to amplify tail.

Chen: release-notes-bot, add short line: "Pinned rerank (eu-west) to v2.9.8 during canary due to 5xx spike; retaining canary in other regions. Investigating sharded model warming/regression."

release-notes-bot: PR updated https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/358 with note at 4444444520

Marta: decision: keep rerank pinned in eu-west until eng-runtime validates a fix or we can A/B a reduced prefetch flag. Re-evaluate after 20m of stable metrics in other lanes. If fix looks good, we will re-roll rerank in eu-west with controlled warm-up.

Riley: adding eng-ml and oncall to monitor channel. Will post p95/5xx cadence every 5m.

Chen: created incident ticket INC-6124 and assigned eng-runtime + eng-ml for RCA.

Marta: summary for PMs: localized canary instability in eu-west rerank; targeted pin applied to avoid customer impact; canary continues elsewhere; engineering investigating model warm-up policy.

eng-runtime: I'll follow up here with heatmaps and proposed flag CL. Leaving thread open for updates.

Marta: thanks everyone. Closing for now, re-open if we see further cross-region regressions. :thumbsup:
